contexts.text: The gentiles... acknowledged the immortality of the soul.
Hence (the Sophi) concluded concerning the immortality of the lower mind.
Thence came to (the Greeks and Romans) Knowledges concerning... the immortality of the soul.
Thence they perceived that their soul was immortal...
The soul of man, concerning the immortality of which many have written, is his spirit; for this is immortal as to all things of it.
(The reason of man's immortality.) NJHD 35:2. AE 547:2.

The reason why many of the intelligent, so called, in the Christian world, do not believe in the immortality of their own life... is that at heart they deny the Divine, and instead of the Divine acknowledge nature...

Can you believe that the ancient Sophi... who... wrote about the immortality of the soul, took it first from proprium. No; but from others who had it by tradition from those who first learned it from the (Ancient) Word. TCR 273. DeVerbo 6:end.
That without these two faculties, man would not have immortality and eternal life. Explained.
By means of conjunction (with the Lord) man has immortality; and by means of reformation and regeneration he has eternal life... Therefore every man has immortality...
It is from this Knowledge implanted in everyone that some aspire to an immortality of fame...
In order that man may live to eternity, that which is mortal with him is taken away... Thus his Immortal is laid bare, which is his mind, and then becomes a Spirit in a human form...
It descended from Heaven into their general perception that God is wisdom itself, of which man is a partaker, and God is immortal or eternal.
The freedom of his will cannot be taken away for him to be a man and thence immortal.

Concerning the immortality of the soul (the Angels) said, Man lives to eternity because he can be conjoined with God by love and faith. This everyone can be. And that this ability makes the immortality of the soul, you can understand if you think a little deeply about it. CL 132:3. TCR 621.
The wise ones of Greece said... While we were in the world we believed in the immortality of the souls of men, from the inductions which reason supplied to us.
All you are Souls, about whose immortality you have heard so many things... and because you are forms of love and wisdom from God, you cannot die to eternity.
The Angels are glad that it has pleased the Lord to disclose such things, to prevent man from being, from ignorance, any longer in doubt concerning his own immortality.
Whence are your souls, which are immortal?
On the immortality of the soul.

I began to think that there are men who affect an immortality of fame... from which it might be evident that something has moved them to a longing for immortality... as was also the case with the Romans, of whom it is known that they affected immortality more than others... of whom many scarcely thought about the immortality of the soul...
I perceived that the reason is, that the Lord infuses into everyone a perception of immortality... and that this is a general influx into all...
5. (Why animals and plants are not immortal, and men are. Explained.)
That the life of man after death, and the immortality of his soul, are from the gift of this free will...
